content.title: About
content.content: Soft drink NFS is a carbonated beverage with a mixed berry flavor, designed to refresh at any time. It contains water, sugar, flavorings, acids and carbon dioxide, giving it a characteristic fizzy taste.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: NFS was first launched in 1998 as part of the “New Fruit Sensation” line.
Thanks to natural berry flavorings, the drink has a brighter taste compared to traditional colas.
Each can contains about 30 mg of caffeine, providing a moderate stimulant effect.
The aluminum packaging is fully recyclable and preserves the drink’s aroma longer than glass.
In some countries NFS is released in limited seasonal flavors, such as “Summer Raspberry”.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Water, which makes up the majority of the drink, helps maintain the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Sugar and a small amount of caffeine can quickly raise energy levels.

items.title: Vitamin profile
items.content: Small amounts of vitamin C and B‑vitamins added to the formula support metabolic processes.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Regular consumption may contribute to weight gain and increase the risk of dental caries.

items.title: Caffeine
items.content: People sensitive to caffeine should limit their intake of the drink.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Acids (phosphoric, citric) can irritate the stomach lining when consumed in excess.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The drink is best served chilled, straight from the bottle or a glass. It can also be used as a base for cocktails, mixers, and dessert sauces.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, consume within 2‑3 days and keep the cap tightly closed.
